contract.description: Single authoritative financial fact per company per business term per fiscal period. The base zone's conformed view that all consumable tables read from.

fields.name: conformed_id
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of grain fields, truncated to 16 hex chars. Primary key.

fields.name: source_fact_id
fields.description: FK to base.financial_facts.fact_id. The winning fact from collision resolution.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: FK to base.entity_mappings.mapping_id. Resolved entity identity.

fields.name: cik
fields.description: SEC Central Index Key. Part of grain.

fields.name: canonical_name
fields.description: Normalized company display name.

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Primary stock ticker symbol.

fields.name: business_term_id
fields.description: FK to business glossary (BT-022 through BT-048). Part of grain.

fields.name: business_term
fields.description: Human-readable business term name.

fields.name: financial_statement
fields.description: Statement classification: income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow_statement, per_share, other.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Financial metric subcategory.

fields.name: source_concept
fields.description: The XBRL concept that won collision resolution.

fields.name: val
fields.description: Financial value from the winning fact.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Measurement unit after unit filtering (USD or USD/shares).

fields.name: fiscal_year
fields.description: Fiscal year of reporting period. Part of grain.

fields.name: fiscal_period
fields.description: FY, Q1, Q2, Q3. Part of grain.

fields.name: fiscal_year_end
fields.description: Fiscal year end in MMDD format.

fields.name: period_end_date
fields.description: Calendar date of reporting period end.

fields.name: calendar_year
fields.description: Calendar year of period_end_date.

fields.name: calendar_quarter
fields.description: Calendar quarter (1-4) of period_end_date.

fields.name: accession_number
fields.description: SEC accession number of the winning fact's filing.

fields.name: filed_date
fields.description: Date the winning fact's filing was submitted to the SEC.

fields.name: competing_fact_count
fields.description: Number of candidate facts that competed for this grain (>= 1).

fields.name: selection_reason
fields.description: Why this fact won: sole_candidate, primary_concept, or tier_frequency_fallback.

fields.name: promoted_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when written to base zone.

fields.name: load_date
fields.description: Pipeline run date.

quality.freshness_sla: Updated within 7 days of pipeline run (development); tighten to 24-48 hours in production.
quality.uniqueness_guarantee: Exactly one row per (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). Enforced by DQ rules BASE-CF-001 and BASE-CF-002.
quality.referential_integrity: Every source_fact_id exists in base.financial_facts. Enforced by DQ rule BASE-CF-003.
quality.coverage: All 20 in-scope companies and all 25 business terms represented. Enforced by BASE-CF-004 and BASE-CF-005.

lineage.trace_path: conformed_facts.source_fact_id -> financial_facts.fact_id -> raw grain fields -> SEC filing

breaking_changes.policy: Semantic versioning. Breaking changes (grain change, column removal, type change) require a new major version and 30-day deprecation notice. All five consumable tables depend on this contract.
